text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can produce paintings, compose music, and even write stories or poems. Some people are amazed by these results, while others worry that machines might replace human artists. However, the truth is more complex. AI learns from existing human works, copying patterns and styles, but it doesn't have emotions, experiences, or personal intentions. Human creativity comes from life, feelings, and unique perspectives. So, rather than replacing us, AI can be a helpful tool or a source of inspiration. The real question is not whether machines can be creative, but how we choose to use them alongside our own imagination.
